alex_mgr: Quick Q — I have a direct (S. Patel) who hit all expectations and led a cross-team infra effort. Thinking about a "spotlight" promo midcycle to L4. Anyone have process tips?
jamie_peopleops: Congrats! Short version: midcycle moves are allowed but need manager justification + calibration doc + comp approval. Can you paste a 2-3 bullet impact note here? :tada:
alex_mgr: Sure. Bullets:
- Led infra reduction project, reduced token-cost infra spend by ~18% across services
- Mentored two new hires who shipped key telemetry
- Took on oncall rotation and improved mean-time-to-detect
Would that be enough?
jamie_peopleops: Sounds promising. We evaluate on scope, consistency, and comp delta. For midcycle, target must be within current band + up to one band unless exceptional. Please include before/after title and proposed base delta.
susan_ic: FYI — I filed a similar midcycle last cycle. Manager note + peer feedback helped. Also include customer/partner quotes if available.
alex_mgr: Proposed: title stays IC3 -> IC4, base +12%. Is that within policy?
jamie_peopleops: +12% is okay for strong midcycle but we'll route to comp committee. Two next steps: 1) fill this template (paste below) and 2) ping payroll_bot once comp committee approves so we can schedule effective date.
jamie_peopleops: Template:
```
Name:
Current title/band:
Proposed title/band:
Proposed base change (% and $):
Business justification (3 bullets):
Evidence (links):
Peer/skip-level feedback summary:
Manager recommended effective date:
```
payroll_bot: Heads up: for midcycle with retro pay, payroll lead needs final decision by EOD Fri to hit next month.
alex_mgr: Copying template filled:
Name: S. Patel
Current title/band: IC3 / Band 3
Proposed title/band: IC4 / Band 4
Proposed base change (% and $): +12%, $9,600
Business justification (3 bullets): Led infra reduction (~18%), mentored hires, stabilized oncall; measurable impact on latency and cost
Evidence (links): https://redwood/doc/infra-savings, https://redwood/reviews/s-patel
Peer/skip-level feedback summary: Positive across infra/product, noted ownership and cross-team coordination
Manager recommended effective date: 2026-05-01
jamie_peopleops: Great — I'll kick this to comp committee. Expect a reply within 5 business days. If approved, we'll coordinate comp letter and backpay logistics. :white_check_mark:
alex_mgr: Thanks. One last Q: can comp be backdated to the start of the month if approved late?
jamie_peopleops: Yes, usually effective date is the manager recommended date up to payroll cutoffs. If committee approves after payroll closes, we can backdate to the manager recommended effective date but payroll may process retro adjustment on next cycle. We'll confirm when committee responds.
alex_mgr: 👍 thanks all, appreciate the quick help.
